name: We’ll Meet Once More
source:
Every day is the same. Go to school, stare out the window. Go home, play video games. Your life is a blur of monotony that repeats over and over…

Until a transfer student breezes into your life, changing your world forever.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.livershort&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dlivershort_web]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
每一天都一样。上学，望着窗外发呆。回家，打电子游戏。你的生活是一片不断重复、模糊而单调的日常……

直到一位转学生轻快地闯入你的生活，永远改变了你的世界。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.livershort&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dlivershort_web]Google Play[/url]]
